theater: 藏南高原與阿克賽欽邊線

battle.name: 中印邊境戰爭
battle.theater: 藏南高原與阿克賽欽邊線
battle.brief: 一九六二年十一月二十日，解放軍在藏南與阿克賽欽同時發動攻勢，二十一日即宣佈停火並後撤。戰役以步兵夜間突進與山嶺炮兵對射為主，印軍在納都拉、巧拉、楚舒爾三處受挫。卡面這支一八五〇年德國線膛野戰砲代表的，正是砲兵以射程壓過步兵的技術路線；一九六二年由後膛式山炮與榴彈砲延續。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 這場戰爭是中華人民共和國與印度共和國之間沿實際控制線爆發的邊境戰事，交戰主力是中國人民解放軍與印度軍隊。解放軍方面，由總參謀部與新疆軍區統籌，實際控制線東段以西藏方向的前線部隊為主，投入第四軍群、第五軍群及後續開進的兵團，並配屬工程兵、通信兵與後勤分隊，攻勢分作兩路：藏南一路沿邊境線由西向東推，阿克賽欽一路則由新疆方向南切，切斷列城至斯利那加的公路。印度方面由陸軍本部指揮，共投入四個師，其中第十五步兵師、第八山地師、第十山地師是攻勢與防守的骨幹，第四野戰軍統一編制下轄各師；炮兵由炮兵部隊集中支援，工兵、通信兵、醫療與後勤按旅營編制跟進，後方另設專門的邊疆補給指揮部。兩國交戰並非國家全體之間的戰爭，而是一次被雙方最高層壓在極短時間內、在數百公里分散戰線上同時展開的有限邊境交鋒。
countriesEn: This war was a border conflict fought between the People's Republic of China and the Republic of India along the line of actual control, with the Chinese People's Liberation Army and the Indian Army as the opposing forces. On the Chinese side the campaign was directed by the PLA General Staff together with the Xinjiang Military Region. Along the eastern stretch of the line the forward units facing Tibet carried the main effort, with the Fourth Army Group, the Fifth Army Group and army groups moved up afterwards committed to the operation, supported by engineer, signal and service detachments. The offensive was split into two prongs: in the south an advance eastward along the frontier in the Tibet sector, and in the west a thrust southward out of Xinjiang that cut the Leh to Srinagar road. On the Indian side the army headquarters directed the operations and committed four divisions in all, of which the 15th Infantry Division, the 8th Mountain Division and the 10th Mountain Division formed the core of both the attacking and the defending force. A single field army corps controlled the committed divisions, artillery support was centralised under the artillery units, and engineer, signal, medical and service elements followed in brigade and battalion echelons, with a separate border logistics command organisation set up in the rear. This was not a war between the two states as a whole, but a limited border clash that both high commands tried to keep short in duration, fought at the same time across a front several hundred kilometres long.
people: 決定開打與不開打的是毛澤東。一九六二年秋，中印邊界談判破裂、印軍在藏南各處前哨不斷推進之際，毛澤東拍板用兵，並要求一旦交手就打成殲滅戰，而不是拖成反覆糾纏的邊界衝突；周恩來在外交上把關，把照會與談判留到最後關頭。作戰層面，解放軍總參謀長黃永勝主持前線部署，新疆軍區司令員王震負責西線，即阿克賽欽方向，西藏軍區司令員張國華負責東線，即藏南方向，前線師與旅級指揮員依多路穿插、各個殲滅的原則自行安排進攻序列。印度方面，政治層面是總理尼赫魯推動前進政策，國防部長克里希那·梅塔主張加強邊防軍力，陸軍參謀總長 V. K. Mehra 少將主張佔領整條麥克馬洪線；作戰層面，第四野戰軍司令 J. N. Thimpe 少將指揮那木拉、巧拉方向，第十山地師師長 B. M. Vohra 少將守楚舒爾，第十一旅旅長 P. S. Lamba 准將在最激烈的納都拉山口。
peopleEn: The man who decided whether there would be a war was Mao Zedong. In the autumn of 1962, when the Sino-Indian border talks had broken down and Indian forward posts were pushing forward all along the southern frontier, Mao took the decision to use force and insisted that once the shooting started it should be a war of annihilation rather than a prolonged running border quarrel. Zhou Enlai held the diplomatic end, keeping the notes and the negotiations alive until the very last moment. At the operational level the PLA Chief of the General Staff Huang Yongsheng ran the deployment of the forward forces, the commander of the Xinjiang Military Region Wang Zhen took the western flank, the Aksai Chin direction, and the commander of the Tibet Military Region Zhang Guohua took the eastern flank, the southern sector. Divisional and brigade commanders there arranged their own sequences of attack on the principle of attacking by several routes and destroying the enemy in separated groups. On the Indian side the political decisions came from Prime Minister Nehru, who pushed the forward policy, and from Defence Minister Krishna Menon, who argued for a stronger border force. The Chief of the Army Staff, General V. K. Mehra, pressed for the occupation of the entire McMahon Line. Operationally, Lieutenant General J. N. Thimpe, commanding the Fourth Army Corps, directed the Nathu La and Cho La sectors; Major General B. M. Vohra, commanding the 10th Mountain Division, held Chushul; and Brigadier P. S. Lamba, commanding the 11th Brigade, led the defence at the fiercest point of all, the Nathu La pass.
kits: 卡面這件線膛野戰砲是一八五〇年德國即普魯士兵工廠的早期線膛野戰砲，線膛炮管、前膛裝填，射程比同期滑膛砲倍增，正是十九世紀中期砲兵第一次能在射程上壓過步兵的那道技術門檻；它在一九六二年早已淘汰逾一百年，戰場上不可能出現，但它開出的那條路一直延伸到本役的火砲。解放軍在藏南與阿克賽欽使用的火力以五三式一二〇毫米迫擊砲與五四式一二二毫米榴彈砲為主，另有八二毫米迫擊砲與七五毫米無後坐力砲；步兵輕武器為五六式半自動步槍、五六式自動步槍與五六式衝鋒槍，機槍有五三式重機槍與五六式輕機槍，另有手榴彈與爆破器材。印軍的輕武器仍以李-恩菲爾德七點六二毫米步槍為主力，配斯特林衝鋒槍與布侖機槍，火砲有二十五磅砲、一〇五毫米野砲、五點五吋砲、三點七吋山砲，迫擊砲有八十一毫米與一二〇毫米兩種，還有火箭砲。運輸方面，解放軍靠解放牌汽車、騾馬與犛牛背運，印軍靠吉普、貨車與大量騾馬，並配發雪地裝備與登山器材。
kitsEn: The muzzle-loading field gun on the card is an early rifled field gun from the German, that is Prussian, arsenals of 1850. With a rifled barrel and loading from the muzzle, it doubled the range of the smoothbore guns of its day and marked the threshold at which artillery could for the first time outrange and beat infantry. It had been obsolete for more than a century by 1962 and could not of course appear on the battlefield, but the line it opened runs straight into the guns of this war. The artillery used by the PLA in the southern sector and in Aksai Chin consisted mainly of the 53-type 120mm mortar and the 54-type 122mm howitzer, together with 82mm mortars and 75mm recoilless rifles. The infantry weapons were the 56-type semi-automatic rifle, the 56-type automatic rifle and the 56-type submachine gun, with the 53-type heavy machine gun and the 56-type light machine gun, plus grenades and demolition stores. The Indian light weapons were still centred on the 7.62mm Lee-Enfield rifle, with Sterling submachine guns and Bren light machine guns; their artillery included the 25-pounder, the 105mm L1 field gun, the 5.5-inch gun, the 3.7-inch mountain gun, 81mm and 120mm mortars and rocket artillery. For transport the PLA relied on Jiefang trucks, mules and yaks carrying loads on their backs, while the Indians used jeeps, lorries and a great many mules, with issued snow clothing and mountaineering equipment.
tactics: 印軍一開始採前哨政策，在實際控制線印方一側建立大量不設防或輕設防的前哨，兵力沿山脊縱深梯次配置，企圖用既成事實迫中承認麥克馬洪線。但山地通信困難，各前哨與師部之間靠無線電中繼加步行信使，命令往往到不了；後方補給線穿過海拔四千米以上的山口，靠騾馬、雪橇與人力搬運，一口糧、一發砲彈要走上幾天。解放軍的戰術與之相反：先以夜戰行軍拉開距離，在黎明前對印軍陣地發動密集突進，突擊重點是印軍外圍的薄弱前哨與通信中繼，不求全線殲滅，只求在關鍵點上以多倍兵力吃掉一個點，然後迅速轉用另一路。楚舒爾方向是一個典型：十一月七日拂曉，解放軍攻入機場跑道與油料區，切斷印軍的空投與後送，印軍雖有第四野戰軍的預備隊卻無法反攻。那木拉與巧拉則是攻堅，解放軍以步兵在夜色裡摸上山口，突破工事後轉入刺刀距離的短兵相接。整條戰線上解放軍沒有出動空軍，印軍在制空與偵察上佔優，並曾出動轟炸機打擊楚舒爾與那木拉方向的中國陣地。
tacticsEn: The Indians began with a forward post policy, establishing a large number of undefended or lightly fortified outposts on their own side of the line of actual control, the troops distributed in depth along the ridgelines, in the hope that fait accompli would force China to accept the McMahon Line. But communications in the mountains were poor. Between the outposts and divisional headquarters the link was a chain of radio relay stations supplemented by foot messengers, and orders often failed to arrive. The rear supply line ran through passes above four thousand metres, with food, ammunition and fuel carried by mules, sledges and men, so that a single ration or a single shell took days to move. The Chinese tactics were the opposite. They opened the distance with night movement, then launched dense attacks on the Indian positions before first light. The point of the attack was the weak outpost line and the communications relay on the Indian flanks. They did not seek general annihilation along the whole front; they sought to overwhelm one point at a time with several times the enemy's strength and then shift quickly to the next sector. Chushul is the typical case. In the grey light of 7 November the Chinese took the airfield strip and the fuel area, cutting the Indian parachute and supply route, and although the Fourth Army Corps had reserves in hand it could not counterattack. Nathu La and Cho La were assaults on prepared positions: Chinese infantry climbed the passes in the dark, broke through the field works and then fought at bayonet range. Along the entire front the PLA committed no aircraft. The Indian Air Force held the advantage in the air and in reconnaissance and flew bombing attacks against Chinese positions in the Chushul and Nathu La sectors.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。爭議的實際控制線全線約三千五百公里，印方主張的麥克馬洪線全長約三千四百公里，兩線在藏南一段相距不過數百米至數公里。兵員方面，解放軍第一批投入的攻勢部隊約三萬人，全役高峰時在前線作戰與支援的兵力接近十萬人，來自兩個軍群與後續開進的兵團；印度以四個師投入，攻勢方向約四萬至五萬人，陸軍總兵力在二十萬上下。時間軸上，前哨衝突自一九六二年九月十八日解放軍驅逐塔旺方向的印軍前哨起，十一月七日爆發楚舒爾戰鬥，十一月二十日全面開打，十一月二十一日中國宣布停火，十二月二十日完成撤軍。傷亡方面，印度官方公布陣亡三千九百二十八人，輕重傷合計逾一萬，被俘約一萬一千九百人，其後獲釋返還約三千八百人；中國官方公布作戰陣亡二千六百四十八人。砲兵射程上，印軍一〇五毫米野砲有效射程約十一公里，三點七吋山砲約四公里，解放軍一二〇毫米迫擊砲約四公里、一二二毫米榴彈砲最大射程約十一公里。地形數字：那木拉山口海拔約四千三百米，巧拉接近五千米，楚舒爾距實際控制線不足一百公里。印軍在開戰前曾派五百餘名專家在列城完成高山作戰與雪地裝備訓練。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The disputed line of actual control runs for about three thousand five hundred kilometres in all, while the McMahon Line claimed by India is about three thousand four hundred kilometres long; in the southern sector the two lines are separated by no more than a few hundred metres in some places and by a few kilometres in others. On strength, the first Chinese assault formations numbered about thirty thousand men, and at the height of the campaign close to one hundred thousand troops were fighting or in support on the front, drawn from two army groups and army groups moved up afterwards. India committed four divisions, of which roughly forty to fifty thousand men took part in the offensive, against an army of some two hundred thousand overall. On the timeline, the clash at the outposts began on 18 September 1962, when Chinese troops drove out the Indian posts in the Tawang sector; the battle of Chushul was fought on 7 November; the general attack opened on 20 November; China announced a ceasefire on 21 November; and the withdrawal was complete by 20 December. On casualties, India officially published 3,928 dead, more than ten thousand wounded of both degrees, and about 11,900 men taken prisoner, of whom some 3,800 were later released and returned. China officially published 2,648 dead in action. On artillery ranges, the Indian 105mm field gun had an effective range of about eleven kilometres, the 3.7-inch mountain gun about four, the Chinese 120mm mortar about four, and the 122mm howitzer a maximum range of about eleven kilometres. On terrain, the Nathu La pass lies at roughly 4,300 metres, Cho La approaches five thousand, and Chushul is less than a hundred kilometres from the line of actual control. Before the fighting began, India sent more than five hundred specialists to Ladakh to be trained in mountain warfare and in the use of snow clothing.
cause: 直接起因是實際控制線一線長期存在的進退之爭。一九五四年中印協定以和平共處五項原則為框架，雙方約定以現有實際控制線為基礎談判解決邊界問題；但中印對西段界線的認識從未一致，一九五六年中國政府明確提出阿克賽欽在中國境內，印方不接受，麥克馬洪線的爭議就此固定下來。一九六〇年中印互換照會，中國提出包括西段以實際控制線為基礎、中段劃出緩衝區在內的十二點方案，印方未採。一九六一年八月揚根衝突後，印軍加強前哨，一九六二年印度大選之後新政府推行前進政策，前線指揮官自行越線建立據點，把國策變成既成事實。九月十八日解放軍以武力驅逐了塔旺方向的印軍前哨，此後塔旺、朗久、零嘎一帶相繼交火；九月二十二日中國外交部照會要求雙方後退，印方拒絕。十月印度總理在國會指責中國越界，並宣布軍隊將把進犯者逐出印度領土，而中方的談判同期已告破裂，於是十月完成作戰部署，十一月二十日全面開火。
causeEn: The immediate cause was the long running argument over who would give way along the line of actual control. The 1954 Sino-Indian agreement was framed by the five principles of peaceful coexistence, and the two sides undertook to negotiate the boundary on the basis of the existing line of actual control. Their understanding of the western sector never matched, however. In 1956 the Chinese government stated explicitly that Aksai Chin lay within Chinese territory; India would not accept this, and the dispute over the McMahon Line was thereby fixed in place. In 1960 the two governments exchanged notes, China offering a twelve-point formula that included taking the western sector as the line of actual control and creating a buffer zone in the middle sector; India declined. After the clash at Galibagh in August 1961 the Indians reinforced their outposts, and after the Indian general election of 1962 the new government pressed the forward policy, forward commanders establishing posts across the line on their own initiative and turning a policy into fait accompli. On 18 September Chinese troops drove the Indian outposts out of the Tawang sector by force, and fighting followed in the Tawang, Longju and Namka Chu areas. On 22 September the Chinese foreign ministry sent a note asking both sides to withdraw, and India refused. In October the Indian prime minister accused China of crossing the line in parliament and announced that the army would drive the intruders out of Indian territory, while the Chinese talks had by then already broken down. Deployments were therefore completed during October, and the general attack opened on 20 November.
impact: 戰後的邊界局勢改變了。藏南一段與阿克賽欽西段的控制權落到中國一方，實際控制線整體西移；中國放棄的是實際控制線以南新奪取的前哨地帶，但藏南河谷與塔旺一線仍留在中國控制之下，印方在此後二十多年把主要邊疆精力放在西線對付巴基斯坦，阿克賽欽方向的主權爭議要到一九八七年才正式提出並進入談判。印度國內的震動更大：總理尼赫魯的聲望重挫，軍隊指揮層被大改組，邊防裝備、軍用公路與空軍現代化計劃在慘敗後加速推進，與美國簽訂武裝部隊關係協定，印度並在一九六三年把國防研發資源轉向核計畫。中國方面，這個結果鞏固了西南邊防，也推動青藏公路與新藏公路的建設速度，一九六二年之後西藏邊防的後勤點與哨所體系被大幅加密。同時這場戰爭在聯合國引起反彈：一九六二年十二月聯合國大會通過第一七六一號決議敦促中印以談判解決邊界問題，中國代表指其干涉內政。對全球冷戰格局而言，此役說明亞洲大國的邊界糾紛可以在數週內變成大規模地面戰，而核門檻並不能阻止常規部隊在邊境上廝殺。
impactEn: The border situation was transformed. Control of a stretch of the southern sector and of western Aksai Chin passed to China, and the line of actual control shifted west as a whole. What China gave up was the newly taken strip of outposts lying south of the line, but the southern valleys and the Tawang area remained under Chinese control, and India for the next two decades concentrated its main frontier effort on the western sector against Pakistan, the sovereignty dispute over Aksai Chin not being formally raised and negotiated until 1987. The shock inside India was the greater one. The standing of Prime Minister Nehru collapsed, the command structure of the army was reshuffled, and plans for border equipment, military roads and air force modernisation were pushed forward after the defeat. India signed an armed forces agreement with the United States, and in 1963 turned part of its defence research resources towards the nuclear programme. On the Chinese side the outcome consolidated the southwestern frontier and speeded up work on the Qinghai-Tibet and Xinjiang-Tibet highways; after 1962 the network of supply points and posts along the Tibetan border was greatly thickened. The war also caused friction at the United Nations: in December 1962 the General Assembly adopted resolution 1761 urging India and China to settle the boundary question by negotiation, and the Chinese representative called this interference in domestic affairs. For the global Cold War picture, the campaign showed that a border dispute between Asian powers could become a large-scale ground war in a matter of weeks, and that the nuclear threshold did not stop conventional troops from killing each other along a frontier.
result: 就一九六二年這一役的直接結果而言：中國在戰術上取得全面勝利，納都拉與巧拉兩個山口被突破，楚舒爾的機場與陣地一度易手，印軍多支前哨分隊被包圍殲滅或被俘；印度陣亡三千九百餘人，被俘約一萬一千九百人，戰線後退數十公里。中國在十一月二十一日宣布單方面停火，隨後依主動讓步的原則把部隊撤回一九六二年九月以前的控制線，最遲在十二月二十日完成撤退；但藏南河谷與阿克賽欽西段並未交還，實際控制線往西移了數十公里。長期結果則是拉鋸的開始：一九六三年中印邊界問題小組會談破裂，一九八六年印度陸軍參謀總長訪問北京，開啟邊防合作對話，一九八八年雙方後勤局局長會晤，制度化的邊防磋商由此起步，一九九六年簽署邊界信任措施條約，二〇一二年成立邊防事務協調委員會。整整半個多世紀，兩國在實際控制線上再沒有爆發大規模地面戰，最接近的一場是二〇二〇年六月的加勒萬河谷衝突。
resultEn: As to the immediate outcome of the 1962 campaign: China won a complete tactical victory. The Nathu La and Cho La passes were broken through, the airfield and positions at Chushul changed hands for a time, and several Indian outpost detachments were surrounded, destroyed or captured. India lost more than 3,900 dead, had about 11,900 men taken prisoner, and the front was pushed back tens of kilometres. China announced a unilateral ceasefire on 21 November and then, on the principle of making the concession itself, withdrew its troops to the line held in the months before September 1962, completing the withdrawal by 20 December at the latest; but the southern valleys and western Aksai Chin were not given back, and the line of actual control had moved west by tens of kilometres. In the longer term a long contest began. The 1963 Sino-Indian border talks broke down; the Indian Chief of the Army Staff visited Beijing in 1986, opening the door to border cooperation talks; the two directorates of logistics met in 1988, and institutional border consultations grew out of that; a border confidence-building treaty was signed in 1996; and the Border Affairs Coordination Committee was set up in 2012. For more than half a century the two countries did not fight another large-scale ground war on the line of actual control, the closest thing to it being the Galwan Valley clash of June 2020.
